images.author: NIAID
images.why: Caption identifies a colourised SEM of yellow HIV particles on a blue-green human H9 T cell. Strong colour separation for a 9:10 crop. Source-linked original; pixel dimensions could not be verified.

images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
images.why: PHIL 18143: colourised SEM showing mustard-yellow HIV particles attached to a red H9 T cell. Excellent subject match. This direct file is the lower-resolution preview; the page separately offers a 9.03 MB download.

images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
images.why: PHIL 18142: colourised TEM showing a single HIV particle budding from an infected human immune cell. A focused alternative for the card. Direct file is the lower-resolution preview; the page offers a 10.78 MB download.

images.author: CDC / C. Goldsmith, P. Feorino, E. L. Palmer, W. R. McManus
images.why: PHIL 11279: colourised SEM explicitly identifying green HIV-1 virions on a cultured human lymphocyte and its projections. Direct file is the lower-resolution preview; the page offers an 18.07 MB download.

images.author: CDC / Dr. A. Harrison; Dr. P. Feorino
images.why: PHIL 10860: colourised thin-section TEM of actual HIV virions, useful for a particle-focused card; caption does not identify T-cell attachment. Direct file is the lower-resolution preview; the page offers a 7.92 MB download.
